html:
While there are many providers of mobile window tinting in gold coast, we believe that to get the highest standards in quality, you need to have your car tinted in a controlled environment. That’s why all our car window tinting is done in house, in a carefully controlled environment free from dust and other flying particles. This is not always possible with mobile car window tinting.

Our Range of Window Tint Films

Our range of automotive window tint films includes:

  • Octane – our darkest legal window tint, perfect for those looking for the ultimate privacy. With 2 dark colour shades, Octane is exclusive to Tint a Car and comes with the added protection of blocking up to 99% UV rays.
  • Spectre – innovative ceramic infused window tint that results in superior infrared heat rejection and exceptional fade resistance. Spectre comes in arrange of tint colours, allowing you to choose the right shade of tint that matches your lifestyle needs.
  • Formula One – with SPF 50+ protection, Formula One offers crystal clear views inside and out while still providing maximum heat and glare rejection. Perfect for those looking for a clear car window tint solution.

Get a Quote

With a range of high-quality films, many locations and exceptional service, it’s no wonder why we’re one of the best providers of car window tinting in Gold Coast. Learn more about our unmatched quality, backed by a lifetime nationwide warranty, at a price that cannot be beaten. Get a quote today.
